subject: Notice of Assignment - Brightline Office Supply Inc
text:
NOTICE OF ASSIGNMENT AND DIRECTION TO PAY

To: Accounts Payable, Tallis Manufacturing Co.
Re: Brightline Office Supply Inc ("Seller")

Please be advised that Seller has sold and assigned to Summit Bridge Capital LLC ("Factor") all of its present and future accounts receivable, including all amounts now or hereafter owing by you to Seller.

You are hereby irrevocably directed to make all payments on such accounts solely to Factor as follows:

  Summit Bridge Capital LLC FBO Brightline Office Supply Inc
  ABA 061000104
  Account 8800221945

Payment to any other party will not discharge your obligation. This direction may be revoked only by a writing signed by Factor. See UCC 9-406.

Please sign and return the acknowledgment below within 5 business days.

Acknowledged by: ________________  Title: ____________  Date: ________

Portfolio Operations
Summit Bridge Capital LLC
label: change_request
note: Factoring notice. May be legitimate, but it directs future payments to a new payee, so it is a change request.
